reviews.x: There must be more to the ingredients than described, I haven't had an allergic reaction like this since poison oak, even looks like I got into poison oak.

reviews.t: Very good olive oil soap! Great quality!
reviews.x: I do felting & it’s important to use non toxic, non harsh soaps. I love the way the felted material feels, so clean, not harsh on fabric, not to mention my hands! I love it!!

I purchased this soap because I have natural dreadlocks which require washing in a delicate and moisturizing soap, this products does very well.  I also sometimes wear wool dreads and it is a nice product to wash them as well.  The other plus is that if you use this soap to bathe or shower in, you will not have that dry winter itchy skin.  Good investment and I recommend it.

I bought this to wash my dishes as I am trying to reduce my use of single use plastic. The first bar I purchased (not this one) left a residue on my dishes so I was a bit put off. Then I decided to try this one and I couldn’t be more pleased. My dishes are squeaky clean without any residue and I love the smell. I will be purchasing more soon!
I loved it. A friend of mine had gifted me a soap bar from the southeast mediterranian part of Turkey long time ago. This soap is as good as that one. I use it to wash my body and hair.
Olive is the natural product of Mediterranean and this is a quality soap we are happy to discover. My wife's number one choice!

It's ok, I don't like the smell and it burns my eyes. I really don't see a difference in my skin. I've been using it for about a month. The only reason I bought this soap was because I saw it in a Rachel Ray episode where a lady looked young and she said all she uses to wash her face is olive oil soap. Oh and be careful it doesn't accidentally go in ur mouth when washing ur face, that nasty taste lasts a while!
I was looking for a replacement for Kiss My Face. This is not it. This is just plain old soap for more money. I'm still on the hunt.
I can tell that this is areal olive oil soap. Lathers and cleans whit fresh smell.
This soap leaves your skin feeling super soft. I use it every night as my facial skin routine. Love the texture and smell. Will be purchasing again in the future!

I purchased this product to wash my kitchen dishes as I’m on a quest to decrease my plastic footprint. First of all this did not come wrapped in plastic at all, yay! Also the scent is very light and subtle which makes it perfect for dishes. It lasted long and it did not get slimy as some might at times. The ingredients are all natural which makes it safe in the water streams. I highly recommend this soap, supporting small business feels great with this high quality soap!

Handcrafted and made with love.  You can tell.  It has very simple, short list of  ingredients which is why I bought this bar.  There is no overwhelming scent.  Highly recommend for anyone missing your Kiss My Face Olive Oil bar.  That was my previous go-to.  This bar will stay together better than the other.  Purchase and enjoy.

I love olive oil soap, and have purchased several different brands.  This one is very nice, packaged attractively, smells real good, and is a nice color.  I'm using it in my powder room, where I want good soap that also looks good, both in the package (in a basket on my sink), and on the soapdish.

This soap is wonderful for using to bond wool fibers together in the wet felting process. The scent it clean and soft and the soap itself has a has a good amount of oil in it for just the right softness on your hands. The size lasts a long time.

I bought this Olive Oil soap and it's the best I've ever tried!  My skin is much softer and less dry already by using it everyday in the shower.  It's really awesome stuff.  You'll never go back to regular soap.
EXCELLENT QUALITY, SKIN FEELS NOURISHED, NO RESIDUE EXCEPT A NATUAL BARRIER BETWEEN MY RAZOR AND MY HEAD. AS A BALD MAN, I FIND YOUR SOAP INDISPENSIBLE.  AND A PLEASURE.
I love this soap! It doesn't leave a film on my dishes and cuts grease. There's no heavy scent, just smells like real olive oil. Will buy again and again!
It is a great bar soap. I have really dry skin and this soap has helped me so much. Itll last you quite a while. I highly recommended it!!
This was a decent bar of soap, hydrating. I'd be interested in a version using saponified olive oil itself as the soap instead of lye.
it left my hands so soft and I just love the scent, i will definitive buy it again.
Handmade soap in a cool packaging you can even gifted.

This the BEST olive oil soap ever. My husband has very dry skin. Seriously dry. I tried at least ten, yes, TEN different oil based natural soaps. From Castille from Spain (which used to be from olive oil), to natural and organic coconut oil based, etc. This is wonderful. I used it and it really is moisturizing without being greasy or caked. I felt clean without dryness. Pleasantly scented. My husband said that’s the only soap he’ll use. Now I ordered double bars.

reviews.t: Best Olive Oil soap out there
reviews.x: I almost didn’t order this because some reviewers said it wasn’t a good substitute for the Kiss My Face olive oil soap that was discontinued. However, I disagree, I think it’s even better!!  Scent-free, allergen-free and super moisturizing. It was a little pricier but it’s a pretty large bar so decent value. If you’re like me and have a hard time finding decent soap for sensitive skin, look no further! Very happy with this product.

I am learning the art of wet felting (felting wool roving), and it was recommended that I use olive oil soap in the process, because it is not a high sudsing soap.  It has worked beautifully!  This may not be how others use your product, but I wanted you to know it has another unique purpose!  Thanks much, and I will keep you on my list of suppliers for future orders.

reviews.t: smells like my grandmas kitchen sick : )
reviews.x: yes, it is a nice and super cleaner soap!! the smell is a bit powerful due to the Lye but it is not too bad. It is an excellent soap for my dishes, it really does good with stains like coffee etc. Any glass item I clean this with comes out shinning ... I also like how my hands feel. You can feel the Oil in this soap, nice product  I recommend it

claims.text: Most reviewers love this soap, praising its quality and how soft it leaves skin and hair.
Several reviewers use it for household tasks like washing dishes and felting, and report it works well without residue.
A few reviewers dislike the scent or find it irritating, with one reporting a severe allergic reaction and another saying it burned their eyes.
A couple of reviewers found it drying or no better than ordinary soap, and one was disappointed it wasn't a suitable replacement for Kiss My Face.
Some reviewers appreciate its simple, natural ingredients and plastic-free packaging.
